constraints: Default execution mode is observe; only bounded-safe artifact/export writes and read-only verification or sandbox actions are allowed without explicit mode expansion.
When .outcomegraph/policy.yaml is present, it is the effective policy input and repository-level allowlist extensions are preferred over built-in defaults.

Application-code writes to src/**, lib/**, app/**, and packages/**, unrestricted network, dependency mutation commands, and deployment actions remain denied unless explicitly allowlisted in a broader mode.
Policy evaluation is fail-closed: explicit deny wins, explicit allow only enables actions in the active mode, and missing allow entries return POLICY_DENIED.
Agent-supplied IDs must stay within [a-z0-9._-]; optimization paths must be repository-relative and reject control characters, percent-encoding, absolute paths, and traversal.
Policy schema violations or unreadable policy files use exit code 64, and autonomous writes stay blocked while policy integrity or ledger health is degraded.
The repository's current observe policy additionally allows AGENTS.md writes and denies gha workflow_dispatch.
goal: Capture OutcomeGraph v2.1's safe-by-default observe security contract, fail-closed policy evaluation, CLI input sanitization, and the current repository observe policy so another agent can reconstruct the same execution boundary.
